EditTextPreference.app:title: Category suffix letters
EditTextPreference.app:summary: Trailing letters treated as sender category suffixes, e.g. G (govt) S (service) P (promo) T (txn)

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Strip glued suffix
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Also strip a trailing category letter when there is no hyphen (best-effort; may over-strip names ending in those letters)

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Notify by default
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: When off, all senders are muted unless whitelisted or a keyword rule forces a notification

Preference.app:title: Keyword rules
Preference.app:summary: Per-sender rules to force-notify or mute messages on keyword match
